scope: IDEA000027-IDEA000029 and nearby IDEA000022-IDEA000026 only; no review, readiness, novelty, or experiment authorization.

ranked.title: A whole-word candidate binds one botanical part class
ranked.distinctive_prediction: A candidate whole shows a replicated association with one independently indexed root/leaf/seed/flower class across held folios, after section/page controls; unrelated part classes remain near baseline.
ranked.independent_endpoint: partial_available: admitted botanical selectors and prior external-part indexing exist, but a clean held independent part index is not yet established.
ranked.cheapest_decisive_step: Freeze one external part index and score candidate-part association on held folios with alternate readings and section/page controls.
ranked.why_stronger: It binds a concrete external referent class and has an explicit held-folio countermodel; it is more informative than generic role or genre fit. IDEA000015 is a nearby predecessor and must be compared before selection.

ranked.title: Record genre changes field-role distribution
ranked.distinctive_prediction: The same whole has a reproducible role interaction between independently classified description and instruction records, beyond register and position; a portable meaning predicts no interaction.
ranked.independent_endpoint: partial_available: cached record/field classifications exist, but independent genre labels and whole-level role adjudication are missing.
ranked.cheapest_decisive_step: Blindly freeze description/instruction labels for a held record subset, then test one preregistered whole-level genre interaction with leave-one-record-out validation.
ranked.why_stronger: It has a direct portable-meaning countermodel and a cheap record-level endpoint, while remaining distinct from quantity, result latency, owner, antecedent, and role-position proposals.

ranked.title: Modal obligation is distinct from descriptive action
ranked.distinctive_prediction: Candidate-bearing action fields have more independently coded required/forbidden/conditional instructions than matched descriptive fields; a plain action/state reading predicts no modal shift.
ranked.independent_endpoint: unknown: cached procedural contexts exist, but an independent medieval-style modal annotation and held endpoint are not currently established.
ranked.cheapest_decisive_step: Define a small blinded modal rubric from an external source corpus, annotate held candidate contexts, and require annotator agreement before any score.
ranked.why_stronger: It asks a semantic operator question with a concrete falsifier, but ranks below 027/029 because its independent endpoint must be built and the historical modal analogue is less directly bound.

not_selected: IDEA000022 antecedent availability overlaps the existing OLOR anaphoric/temporal route; IDEA000023 degree scope lacks an independent ordinal scale; IDEA000024 action/material role overlaps existing slot-role work; IDEA000025 owner-conditioned referent and IDEA000026 panel deixis overlap owner/deictic candidates and lack sufficient repeated owned cases.
screening: Ran bounded ideas search/show memory checks and exact prediction route-checks for the three ranked designs. No public search, raw/image access, registry review, or experiment was performed.
